posted_text:
🏢 NH SB439 — New Hampshire Cities Can Now Control Data Center Construction

This bill lets New Hampshire cities and towns control where data centers are built. It defines a ‘data center’ as a facility storing and processing digital data, excluding smaller facilities tied to a property owner’s operations. Local zoning boards can permit data centers in commercial and industrial zones, but must create specific rules with local government approval. The changes will take effect 60 days after the bill’s passage. ...
